title: Services
help: Provision VLESS over TCP without TLS on an existing Xray node. This initial workflow creates unlimited services; quota, expiry and other protocols are not available here yet.
coreHelp: First onboard the node from Nodes and run its agent with Xray. Registration connects this record to that existing core; it does not install Xray.
inboundHelp: Enter the exact tag of an existing VLESS/TCP inbound without TLS. The public address and port must be reachable by your clients.
name: Name
level: Xray user level (blank uses the core default)
chooseFirst: Select a core and inbound above to continue.
statusHelp: Status shows the initial provisioning result. Refresh to see worker progress; it is not continuous connection monitoring. Paused delivery can be resumed in the overview schedules.
privateLink: Private subscription URL — select to copy; anyone with this link can connect
failed: Could not complete the operation. Try again.
